description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/compost_notes.xlsx which contains rough notes about composting materials added over 3 months. Organize this messy data into a proper diagnostic spreadsheet with columns: Date, Material, Category (Green/Brown), Estimated Volume, and Notes. Categorize materials as GREEN (nitrogen-rich: kitchen scraps, coffee grounds, grass clippings, fruit waste, weeds) or BROWN (carbon-rich: dry leaves, paper, cardboard, wood chips). Create a formula to calculate the green-to-brown ratio. The notes indicate smell problems started around June 15. Identify the imbalance problem and add a diagnosis noting that too many greens were added. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
